code_summary: ocmseserviceui pages/Furnish/Form/HDQuests.ts, utils/option.ts, utils/validation/Furnish/ValidHirerDriver.ts, utils/validation/error.ts, utils/map/MapFurnish.ts. ocmseserviceapi workflows/furnish/{FurnishRequestValidator,FurnishSubmissionServiceImpl,dto/FurnishSubmissionRequestDTO}. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant.
note: 2-point story, status_with_ura 'Fully paid'. The 'Others' option exists for both individual and UEN hirer IDs, shows an 'Other Relationship' field (min 2, max 50 characters, with a counter), is mandatory, is re-checked on the server and stored in othersRelationshipDesc. The field is cleared again when another option is selected. No gap on this story and no relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Claimable: the whole 'Others' free-text flow works in the UI and on the server.

steps.step: The relationship option "Others" is available for the furnished hirer or driver
steps.detail: Relationship.O labelled 'Others' is in RelationshipOptions (NRIC/FIN/Passport) and RelationshipUENOptions (UEN) (option.ts:38, 42-54). The radio is filled by the hirer ID type (HDQuests.ts:163-181), so for a company owner both an individual and a UEN hirer can select Others.

steps.step: Selecting "Others" shows a free-text field to describe the relationship
steps.detail: onSelect sets isOtherRelation = (value === 'O') (HDQuests.ts:188); when true the hdOtherRelation 'Other Relationship' field is rendered (HDQuests.ts:498-510) with a 50-character limit and a counter (HDQuests.ts:210-221). Selecting another option clears and hides the field (HDQuests.ts:183, 188).

steps.step: The relationship description is mandatory and its length is checked
steps.detail: When hdRelation = 'O', hdOtherRelation is mandatory, minimum 2 and maximum 50 characters (ValidHirerDriver.ts:171-182), with the messages 'Please enter the Relationship information.' / 'Please enter at least 2 characters.' (error.ts:485-489). It is validated live while typing (HDQuests.ts:226-233) and at 'Proceed to review'.

steps.step: The description is re-checked on the server and stored
steps.detail: validateAll calls validateOthersRelationship: when the relationship is Others, othersRelationshipDesc is mandatory and 2-50 characters (FurnishRequestValidator.java:54, 289-308; called at FurnishSubmissionController.java:99). The hdOtherRelation value is mapped to othersRelationshipDesc (MapFurnish.ts:45, 113) and stored (FurnishSubmissionServiceImpl.java:189-190).
